title: Expand Ollama Integration — active callables + agent-loop bridge + Docker deployment
brief: Closes the gap where 21 Ollama hooks + 8 engines existed but only 9% offload rate was observed (vs 30% healthy target). Hooks could only SUGGEST offloads — nothing forced one. This milestone adds three layered active surfaces: (L1) ask-ollama CLI callable Claude invokes via Bash so token-heavy work never enters the context window; (L2) ollama-prism-bridge — read-only agentic harness where an Ollama model autonomously chains 3 knowledge tools (viz_search/wiki_lookup/read_excerpt) via /api/chat tools, running call->execute->feed-back loop locally at ~0 Claude tokens; (L2b) live MCP-dispatcher tools via Streamable HTTP + 4 added tools (tribal_lookup, semantic_search, dispatcher_map, obsidian-precheck) for full PRISM-knowledge reach; ancillary: Docker compose deployment, offload dashboard refinement (adjusted rate computation + keep-category breakdown); deferred L3 = full agent loop (blocked on >3B model availability).
created_by_notes: Backfilled envelope — silent close-out drift. Milestone shipped 7 units across 10 commits (2026-05-17 21:45 to 2026-05-18 19:41) without an envelope file. Documented in CLAUDE.md OLLAMA-EXPAND-MS0 section + memory reference_ollama_expand_ms0 + reference_ollama_prism_bridge_l2 + wiki knowledge/wiki/architecture/ollama-expand-ms0.md + knowledge/wiki/architecture/ollama-prism-bridge.md.

phases.title: Live MCP-dispatcher tools via Streamable HTTP

units.title: Full agent loop — sustained multi-step autonomous reasoning
units.deferral_reason: Needs >3B model. qwen2.5-coder:3b (current keep_alive model) emits mcp_call as text rather than via tool_calls — known L2b deferred limitation documented in reference_audit_actionmap_synergy_chain_2026_05_18. A 7B+ model with reliable tool_use grammar required before sustained multi-step loop is reliable.
units.deferral_owner: any slot with >3B GPU headroom + DUE re-evaluation when NIM llama-3.2-3b setup matures (reference_nvidia_nim_local_setup_2026_05_18)
exit_conditions: Agent autonomously chains >=4 tool calls in a single session without text-emitted-as-tool drift
Tool_use grammar emitted via /api/chat tool_calls field (not as model text)
Test: 5-step PRISM-knowledge investigation runs to completion locally with no Claude tokens consumed
Sustained call-execute-feedback loop survives a tool failure (retry on different tool)
Read-only invariant preserved: no write tools added without explicit scope-expansion roadmap unit
units.description: L3 graduates the bridge from per-task one-shot tool chains (L2/L2b) to a sustained agent loop. Same read-only invariant; only the autonomy depth changes.

acceptance: ask-ollama callable surface live (verified by /ask-local skill); ollama-prism-bridge agent harness operational with read-only invariant proven; live MCP-dispatcher tools reachable via Streamable HTTP at :3100/mcp; Docker compose deployment validates the bridge config; offload dashboard surfaces adjusted-rate + keep-category metrics; L3 deferred with clear unblock criteria.

risks.description: Tool_use drift in <7B models — qwen2.5-coder:3b emits mcp_call as text rather than via tool_calls field; mitigation = treat 3B as L2/L2b ceiling, gate L3 on >=7B with verified tool_use grammar
OOM on full system-graph.json (~370MB); mitigation = MAX_GRAPH_BYTES=80MB cap with R12 fail-loud (already shipped in U-OE01)
Read-only invariant erosion if a future contributor adds write tools without scope expansion; mitigation = Object.freeze'd allowlist + confinePath in bridge code + this envelope's L3 exit_conditions
